_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/touch-scroll/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 320x240. Root is a column, padding 10, gap 8, alignItems flex-start: children start at x=10 and stack downward. sv is size [200,60] -> 10,10,200,60. svf is size [200,60] after sv + gap 8 -> 10,78,200,60. Each viewport holds six 40px rows, so the first row of sv is 10,10,200,40 and the first row of svf is 10,78,200,40.
_derivation.range: Six 40px rows make 240px of content in a 60px viewport: maxOffsetY = 240 - 60 = 180, and there is no horizontal overflow (single column). Asserted inside Main.as.
points: (13,30) is inside the first row of sv, 3px in from its left edge and at mid-height (rows are 40 tall, 10..50): #cccccc.
(13,98) is inside the first row of svf (78..118): #dddddd.
_derivation.not_pinned: Offsets after a drag, the press being withdrawn, the axis lock, the coast direction/clamp and the momentum:false exactness are STATE, asserted inside Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done. The coast DISTANCE is deliberately not pinned: it is a function of the frame clock (see the probe header).
